# Can you really make that appointment under the hours-of-service rules?

> Free hours-of-service trip planner for owner-operators and dispatchers: enter your remaining drive, window and cycle clocks and your stops, and see the schedule with required breaks, 10-hour resets and the real arrival time. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
